an4.4:1.1: catūsu bhikkhave micchāpaṭipajjamāno bālo abyatto asappuriso khataṃ upahataṃ attānaṃ pariharati sāvajjo ca hoti sānuvajjo viññūnaṃ bahuñca apuññaṃ pasavati
an4.4:1.3: mātari bhikkhave micchāpaṭipajjamāno bālo abyatto asappuriso khataṃ upahataṃ attānaṃ pariharati sāvajjo ca hoti sānuvajjo viññūnaṃ bahuñca apuññaṃ pasavati
an4.4:1.4: pitari bhikkhave micchāpaṭipajjamāno …pe… tathāgate bhikkhave micchāpaṭipajjamāno …pe… tathāgatasāvake bhikkhave micchāpaṭipajjamāno bālo abyatto asappuriso khataṃ upahataṃ attānaṃ pariharati sāvajjo ca hoti sānuvajjo viññūnaṃ bahuñca apuññaṃ pasavati
an4.4:1.5: imesu kho bhikkhave catūsu micchāpaṭipajjamāno bālo abyatto asappuriso khataṃ upahataṃ attānaṃ pariharati sāvajjo ca hoti sānuvajjo viññūnaṃ bahuñca apuññaṃ pasavati.
an4.4:2.1: catūsu bhikkhave sammāpaṭipajjamāno paṇḍito byatto sappuriso akkhataṃ anupahataṃ attānaṃ pariharati anavajjo ca hoti ananuvajjo viññūnaṃ bahuñca puññaṃ pasavati
an4.4:2.3: mātari bhikkhave sammāpaṭipajjamāno paṇḍito byatto sappuriso akkhataṃ anupahataṃ attānaṃ pariharati anavajjo ca hoti ananuvajjo viñañūnaṃ bahuñca puññaṃ pasavati
an4.4:2.4: pitari bhikkhave sammāpaṭipajjamāno …pe… tathāgate bhikkhave sammāpaṭipajjamāno …pe… tathāgatasāvake bhikkhave sammāpaṭipajjamāno paṇḍito byatto sappuriso akkhataṃ anupahataṃ attānaṃ pariharati anavajjo ca hoti ananuvajjo viññūnaṃ bahuñca puññaṃ pasavati
an4.4:2.5: imesu kho bhikkhave catūsu sammāpaṭipajjamāno paṇḍito byatto sappuriso akkhataṃ anupahataṃ attānaṃ pariharati anavajjo ca hoti ananuvajjo viññūnaṃ bahuñca puññaṃ pasavatīti.
